# flaggr_flag (Data Source)

Look up a Flaggr feature flag by key, service, and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "flaggr_flag" "checkout" {
  key         = "new-checkout-flow"
  service_id  = data.flaggr_service.api.id
  environment = "production"
}

output "checkout_enabled" {
  value = data.flaggr_flag.checkout.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String) Environment (development, staging, production).
- `key` (String) Flag key.
- `service_id` (String) Service ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `default_value` (String) Default value as JSON.
- `description` (String) Flag description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the flag is enabled.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the flag is publicly evaluable.
- `name` (String) Flag name.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.
- `type` (String) Flag type.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
